turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median days-to-first-order metric, so I cannot give that median. The closest metric is Signup-to-first-order rate, which is the share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up; I can give that share for the October 2026 signup cohort if you want it.
